title: Ongoing
lead: Money, health, shopping and the dates that need something from you.

quickCreate.title: Add something
quickCreate.lead: Start with one of these. A template is optional.
quickCreate.reminderHint: A title and a date. Nothing else required.
quickCreate.listHint: A checklist, from scratch or from a template.
quickCreate.eventHint: Something happening on a day, with sections.
quickCreate.noteHint: Something to keep. Saved to your saved items.

templates.insuranceHint: Company, cost, renewal date and a reminder.
templates.subscriptionHint: Service, price, billing cycle and where to cancel.
templates.appointmentHint: Date, place, what to bring and what to do first.
templates.checkupHint: A test that comes round again, and its last result.
templates.medicationHint: Times of day and the dose you were given.
templates.shopWeeklyHint: Grouped the way a supermarket is laid out.
templates.menuShabbatHint: Courses, guests, and a shopping list when you ask for one.
templates.birthdayHint: Works out the date every year from a birth date.

scheduled.title: Reminders & appointments
scheduled.resultHint: Your own words. Focus repeats them back and nothing more.
scheduled.deleteBody: “{{title}}” will be removed. This cannot be undone.

recurrence.label: Repeats
recurrence.custom: I'll set the next date myself
recurrence.customHint: Nothing is worked out for you — you choose each date when the time comes.

commitments.title: Insurance & subscriptions
commitments.paymentMethodHint: In your own words. Never store a full card number — this stays in your browser.
commitments.remindDaysBefore: Remind me this many days before
commitments.deleteBody: “{{title}}” will be removed from your list.

money.title: Income & expenses
money.deleteBody: This entry will be removed from {{month}}.
money.noBank: Focus does not connect to a bank. Everything here is what you typed.

health.title: Health
health.name: Name
health.dosageHint: Exactly as you were told. Focus never suggests or changes a dose.
health.refillRemindAt: Remind me to get more on
health.disclaimer: Focus stores what you or a professional wrote down. It gives no medical advice, suggests no dose, and is not a substitute for asking someone qualified.

shopping.title: Shopping & food
shopping.templateIndependence: Changing this list never changes the template it came from.
shopping.emptyHint: A shopping list is a name and the things you buy. Start from a template or an empty list.
shopping.emptyMenusHint: A menu is the dishes that come round again — and the shopping they need.
shopping.occasionHint: Your own words — Passover, Rosh Hashanah. Focus keeps no holiday calendar.

menu.title: Menu
menu.shoppingItemsHint: One per line. These are what a shopping list is built from.
menu.makeListBody: {{count}} new items will be added to “{{list}}”. Anything already on the list is left exactly as it is, ticked or not.
menu.makeListNothing: Everything on this menu is already on the list.
menu.deleteBody: “{{title}}” will be removed. Any shopping list you already made from it stays.

now.title: What needs you
now.emptyHint: Things appear here when they become relevant — not before.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.lead: Everything that is asking for something, in one place.
reminders.emptyHint: Reminders appear here on the day they are due.
reminders.localOnly: Reminders are shown inside Focus when you open it. Nothing arrives while this tab is closed — there is no server and no push notification.

privacy.title: Where this is kept
privacy.body: Everything in Focus is saved in this browser only. There is no account, no server and nothing is sent anywhere. Clearing your browser data clears Focus with it.
privacy.noCards: Never store full card numbers or passwords here.
privacy.noMedical: Nothing here is medical or financial advice.
